title: Local comparison of H^m on a C¹ graph with the integral of its Jacobian (supplied step 3)
statement: Let m, k ∈ ℕ, let ι : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{m+k} be linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w, let D ⊆ ℝ^m be open and g : ℝ^m → ℝ^k a map that is C¹ on D. Put G(w) := ιw + ι'g(w) and J(w) := √det(DG(w)*∘DG(w)) with DG(w) = fderiv ℝ G w. Let t > 1 and w₀ ∈ D. Then there is r > 0 with B_r(w₀) ⊆ D (open ball) such that for every measurable B ⊆ B_r(w₀): H^m(G(B)) ≤ t·∫_B J dL^m and ∫_B J dL^m ≤ t·H^m(G(B)). Here H^m = μHE[m] on ℝ^{m+k}, L^m = volume on ℝ^m, ∫_B J dL^m is the lower Lebesgue integral of ENNReal.ofReal∘J over B, t enters as ENNReal.ofReal t, and the inequalities hold in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (m k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid m →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (m + k)) (g : Euclid m → Euclid k) (D : Set (Euclid m)) (t : ℝ) (w₀ : Euclid m), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 g D → 1 < t → w₀ ∈ D → ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball w₀ r ⊆ D ∧ ∀ B : Set (Euclid m), MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ ball w₀ r → μHE[m] ((fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) '' B) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal t * ∫⁻ w in B, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).det)) ∧ ∫⁻ w in B, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (((fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).adjoint ∘L fderiv ℝ (fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) w).det)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal t * μHE[m] ((fun w => ι w + ι' (g w)) '' B)
